credential_authority: the SKAP Vault inside KV is the only PII and credential store for every user, including the StegVerse ecosystem's own; no secret or token is referenced, introduced or moved by this fold
invariants: Every workflow file is registered in surfaces[]; an unregistered or changed one fails closed (tests/test_workflow_surface_registry.py).
A new check is a group in tools/tasks/task_catalog.json, never a new workflow file.
The stable dispatcher carries no workflow_dispatch, schedule, repository_dispatch, issues or workflow_run trigger; a kept surface is pinned by sha256 and unchanged by the fold.

unregistered_workflow_outcome.required_evidence_or_repair: register the file in control/workflow-surface-registry.json surfaces[] or fold it into tools/tasks/task_catalog.json

surfaces.reason: KEEP_EXISTING_SURFACE_UNCHANGED (issue-event writer): on issues opened it assigns the issue with issues: write through pozil/auto-assign-issue and the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN. The issues event cannot be carried by the read-only pull_request/push dispatcher, so it is kept unchanged and not folded or eliminated.

folded.name: Sync overlay from StegDB
folded.reason: Its triggers are workflow_dispatch and a daily schedule that GitHub has disabled for inactivity (state disabled_inactivity; last run 2026-04-09). It is a writer (contents: write; rsync --delete of the StegDB PatentsOverlay into canon/ and git push). This lane carries no dispatch and enables no schedule. Kept verbatim as a record; canon/ is unchanged.

folded.name: Proof HTML
folded.reason: Its one job is a single action step (anishathalye/proof-html@v1.1.0, an HTML link and markup check of the repository); a run block cannot call an action, so the job is carried verbatim as a dispatcher job (same action, same pin, same with:). Its push-on-every-branch and workflow_dispatch triggers are replaced by the dispatcher's: it now runs on every pull request and push to main. The job id is renamed to `proof-html-build` because the dispatcher already carries a `verify` job; its body is unchanged.
